title: SEC7r2: AES-GCM auth failure returns WC_HW_E not AES_GCM_AUTH_E
description: In crypto2dev_cipher(), when AES-GCM decrypt fails authentication (bad tag), the CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_FINALIZE ioctl returns an error. In the sim, sim_finalize_cipher_gcm propagates wc_AesGcmDecrypt's AES_GCM_AUTH_E through sim_finalize, which then sets errno=EIO and returns -1. The port maps EIO→WC_HW_E via crypto2dev_to_wc_err(). On real hardware the driver likely returns EBADMSG which also maps to WC_HW_E. wolfSSL's TLS layer checks for AES_GCM_AUTH_E specifically to generate the correct alert (BAD_RECORD_MAC). WC_HW_E takes a different path and may cause incorrect TLS error handling. Fix: handle EBADMSG→AES_GCM_AUTH_E in the GCM decrypt error path (port level), and update sim to set errno=EBADMSG on auth failure rather than EIO.
